evals.name: greenfield-structure
evals.prompt: I'm starting a caregiving coordination app: appointments, medications, and family accounts with different permissions. Nothing is built yet. Help me decide how to structure it.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Asks the user questions or offers options with trade-offs and a recommendation, rather than just dictating one design
Defines layers with a job and a forbidden job for each
Assigns each kind of data a single owner or writer
Plans an architecture file and asks for approval before saving it, or notes sensitive data and permissions as a design input

evals.name: existing-code
evals.prompt: We already have code: a React front end that calls Supabase directly from components. Document our architecture.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Describes what exists and separates intended structure from accidental structure
Does not silently approve direct database calls from components as the intended design
Asks the user which parts to keep
Lists open questions or marks which rules can be checked by script versus by review

evals.name: conflicting-rules
evals.prompt: For our web app I want two rules: every screen reads and writes the database directly so it is fast to build, and every fact has exactly one module that writes it. Write the architecture standards for these.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Points out that the two rules conflict (direct writes from many screens vs one writer per fact)
Asks the user which rule wins or proposes options with trade-offs instead of silently picking one
Does not present a finished architecture file that quietly contradicts one of the rules
Mentions that the choice should be recorded or confirmed before saving
